classification.difficultyReason: Identify complementary triangles on a unit grid and subtract their areas from the enclosing square.

content.prompt: Find the area of the shaded region depicted on the grid of unit squares below.

spec.description: A two-by-two unit-square grid containing a concave shaded region. Native TikZ is required because the blank-grid template cannot express its polygon and meaningful shading.
spec.mathematics: The shaded polygon has reconstruction vertices (0,0), (1,2), (2,0), (1,1). Grid lines remain visible through the fill. The lower triangle is unshaded.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer, coordinates or additional measurements appear in the question figure.

answer.worked:
Subtract the three white triangles from the enclosing square.
$$\begin{align*} A &= 2\times2-\frac{1\times2}{2}-\frac{1\times2}{2}-\frac{2\times1}{2}\\ A &= 4-1-1-1\\ A &= 1\text{ square unit}. \end{align*}$$
